dry_autumn.pluvial: Don't sow into dry soil: wait for the first useful rain.
dry_autumn.irrigue: Plan an establishment irrigation after sowing.

hot_spring.pluvial: Sow early and choose early varieties, so grain filling ends before the heat.
hot_spring.irrigue: Sow early and choose early varieties, so grain filling ends before the heat.

dry_spring.pluvial: Choose early varieties that finish their cycle sooner.
dry_spring.irrigue: Keep water back for an irrigation during grain filling.

last_season_dry.pluvial: Soil water reserves are probably low: be careful with costly inputs.
last_season_dry.irrigue: Check your irrigation-water allocations before choosing your crops.

ble.name: Wheat
ble.description: Ideal for the climate and soil type of Beni Mellal.
ble.why: Cool weather and moderate rain make wheat an excellent option.

orge.name: Barley
orge.description: Good drought tolerance, suited to follow wheat in a rotation.
orge.why: Its low water demand makes it a good choice to spare the soil between two more demanding crops.

legumineuses.name: Legumes
legumineuses.description: Naturally enrich the soil with nitrogen, useful between two cereals.
legumineuses.why: They improve soil health for the next crop rather than aiming for maximum yield.
